title: SmartUse — Sync Status
description: Who is still syncing canonical records, and how much continuous data they have. A user counts as syncing if their newest canonical epoch started in the last 24 hours.

list.name: estudio
list.label: Estudio
list.description: Recolección = grupo control. Despliegue = grupo inference, sin cuentas de prueba (QA-BACKEND-CHECK / test).

panels.title: Users syncing
panels.description: Users whose newest canonical epoch started in the last 24h, out of all registered users (excluding hard opt-outs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_epoch >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS "Syncing",
  count(*) AS "Registered"
FROM (
  SELECT u.user_id, max(c.start_ts) AS last_epoch
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN canonical_events c ON c.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE u.capture_status <> 'opted_out_hard'
    AND (('$estudio' = 'recoleccion' AND u.experiment_group = 'control')
    OR ('$estudio' = 'despliegue' AND u.experiment_group = 'inference'
        AND lower(btrim(u.university_major)) NOT IN ('qa-backend-check', 'test')))
  GROUP BY u.user_id
) per_user

panels.title: Continuous hours
panels.description: Sum of v_participant_hours over every user in the selected study, syncing or not. Lags by each user's newest epoch, whose duration isn't known until the next one arrives.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(h.captured_hours), 0) AS "Hours"
FROM v_participant_hours h
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = h.user_id
WHERE (('$estudio' = 'recoleccion' AND u.experiment_group = 'control')
    OR ('$estudio' = 'despliegue' AND u.experiment_group = 'inference'
        AND lower(btrim(u.university_major)) NOT IN ('qa-backend-check', 'test')))

panels.title: Days of data (hours / 24)
panels.description: Continuous hours of the selected study divided by 24.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(h.captured_hours), 0) / 24.0 AS "Days"
FROM v_participant_hours h
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = h.user_id
WHERE (('$estudio' = 'recoleccion' AND u.experiment_group = 'control')
    OR ('$estudio' = 'despliegue' AND u.experiment_group = 'inference'
        AND lower(btrim(u.university_major)) NOT IN ('qa-backend-check', 'test')))

panels.title: Per user
panels.description: Every registered user in the selected study, newest epoch first. Last epoch is the start of the user's newest canonical record, not the time of their last sync request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.user_id::text AS "User",
  u.experiment_group AS "Group",
  u.capture_status AS "Capture status",
  u.signup_ts AS "Signed up",
  CASE
    WHEN max(c.start_ts) IS NULL THEN 'never synced'
    WHEN max(c.start_ts) >= now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'syncing'
    ELSE 'stopped'
  END AS "Status",
  count(c.client_record_id) AS "Records",
  COALESCE((SELECT h.captured_hours FROM v_participant_hours h WHERE h.user_id = u.user_id), 0) AS "Hours",
  max(c.start_ts) AS "Last epoch"
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN canonical_events c ON c.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE (('$estudio' = 'recoleccion' AND u.experiment_group = 'control')
    OR ('$estudio' = 'despliegue' AND u.experiment_group = 'inference'
        AND lower(btrim(u.university_major)) NOT IN ('qa-backend-check', 'test')))
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.experiment_group, u.capture_status, u.signup_ts
ORDER BY max(c.start_ts) DESC NULLS LAST
